resources.string: The car says who wrote and what the message says, by voice only.
On. Voice only: the message text is never shown on screen.
A Pro feature. Tap to see Pro.
Off: group chats stay silent. Only messages sent to you directly are read.
At most one message every 20 seconds. Quiet during calls and turn instructions. Car Hub never replies and never sends anything.
Needs notification access to hear WhatsApp messages.
This unit has no speech engine, so messages can\'t be read aloud. Install one in Check voice.
To read your WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business messages aloud while you drive, Car Hub reads the sender\'s name and the message text from their notifications. It uses notification access to do this.

Each message is spoken once and then forgotten. It is never shown on the driving screen and never saved. Car Hub never replies, never sends SMS and never opens the chat. Group messages are skipped unless you allow them. This also works while Car Hub is in the background, as long as notification access is on.
Car Hub stores and uploads nothing, and shares nothing with Ampli Studio or anyone else. Your unit’s own speech engine speaks the message.
Park to read this and switch it on.
